title: Next.js with Drizzle and PostgreSQL
about: A server-rendered Next.js 15 application (App Router, a server action) that lists and creates posts in PostgreSQL through Drizzle ORM. Every tool builds it with `next build` and deploys it the OpenNext way: a server function, static assets, an image optimizer and a CDN in front.
changesFromStarter: `next` is 15.5.26 instead of the starter's 15.4.6. The OpenNext releases SST and the CDK construct build with refuse 15.4.6: their supported ranges start at 15.4.11 (SST's OpenNext 3.9.14) and 15.5.15 (OpenNext 3.10.4).
Every other direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.
sstNotDeployed: `sst diff` builds the site only when its inputs are known. This site's environment carries the database's outputs, so a preview of a stage that was never deployed builds nothing (measured: the preview ran, `.open-next` was not created), and deploying it needs RDS, a NAT gateway and CloudFront, which the benchmark's AWS rules keep for tests that are about them.
